data.why: A plank over a river in the cut becomes a suspension bridge built step by step: the plank snaps, towers and cables hang the deck, the cables tip the towers until anchors tie them back, and wind twists the deck until a truss stiffens it. The camera opens on the plank over the river, stays side-on on the whole bridge for the towers and cables, widens to take in the anchors, and holds on the deck for the twist and the truss.

ideas.idea: lay a plank across a wide river and you have a bridge
a car rolls on and the long plank snaps in the middle
two towers carry steel cables, and the deck hangs from the cables on hangers
a deck hung from cables over towers is a suspension bridge
the car's weight pulls down on the hangers, the cables carry it up over the towers
the sagging cables pull the tower tops inward and the towers tip
the cables run back to huge concrete anchors on both banks, so the towers stand straight
wind makes the light, thin deck twist, as it did at Tacoma Narrows in 1940
a deep steel truss under the deck makes it stiff, so it stops twisting
rails and a tall lamp complete it
calm: the car drives across the finished bridge

sentences.text: If you lay a plank across a wide river, you have a bridge.
But a car rolls on, and the long plank snaps.
So you build two towers and hang the deck from steel cables.
The car's weight hangs on the cables, and they carry it to the towers.
But now the cables pull so hard that both towers tip inward.
So you tie the cables back to concrete anchors of about 60,000 tons each.
But now wind makes the deck twist, like the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940.
So you stiffen the deck with a deep steel truss.
Add rails and a tall lamp to complete it.
Congratulations, you have built a suspension bridge.

shows.does: a plank lies across the river
a car rolls up and the plank snaps in two
two towers rise, cables drape over them, the deck hangs on hangers
outline traces the towers, cables and deck
the car drives across, yellow arrows run down the hangers and up the cables
both towers tip inward, pulled by the cables
concrete anchors appear on both banks, back cables tie to the tower tops, towers stand straight
wind arrows blow and the thin deck twists over
deep steel trusses appear along both sides of the deck and it lies flat again
rails and a tall lamp appear on the bridge
the car drives off over the finished bridge
